name: floor-drag-placeholder
brief: Fix the floor drag-and-drop indicator in DungeonDetailPage. Today a drag hides the dragged card (Opacity 0) and inserts a sized placeholder Border into the BindableLayout-bound FloorListContainer by index; dropping a card on its own slot shows a card-height empty space and no placeholder, and a restore-on-drag-end fix already failed on re-observation. The session replaces the placeholder with a 2-DIU insertion line that is a sibling of the list, positioned by TranslationY from one pure App.Core function (FloorDropIndicator.Locate) that shares the drop resolver, so the indicator and the drop cannot disagree; no drag handler mutates the container children; the dragged card is left visible; and the placeholder machinery and TransientDropTarget band kind are removed. T1 builds and tests the App.Core resolver; T2 builds the view. Because no automated test can start a real WinUI drag, Gate 3 human checks H1-H6 confirm the self-drop, reorders, tracking, and cancel behaviour in the running app.
